Hi Alex,

Quick answers and confirmation:
- Data: the attached sample is intentionally small. Please run end-to-end on the sample and include a short section in your writeup describing how you'd scale the approach to larger volumes (performance considerations, storage, cost).
- Cloud usage: feel free to use a public cloud instance for any benchmarking; just include the commands and instance specs in your README.

Submission checklist:
1) Single archive (.zip or .tar.gz) containing code, tests, README, and a 1–2 page writeup.
2) Name file like: Alex_Sanders_SRE_takehome.zip and upload to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SRE-Takehome-Alex-Sanders or reply to this email with the attachment.
3) Add a short note in the README with the command to run a smoke test.

Review schedule: our internal reviewers will score submissions by Fri May 21 EOD PT and we'll have a short calibration meeting Mon May 24. If you submit early, we'll aim to give feedback faster.

If anything blocks you, tell recruiting (recruiting@talenthire.co) and Marissa will help with logistics or short extensions.

Best of luck — looking forward to your submission.

Michael Grant
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
